E2.text: An official trade record states that AeroExpress Logistics holds IATA Cargo Agent Accreditation.

E4.text: A compliance certificate indicates that AeroExpress Logistics retains ISO 9001 Quality Certification.

B2.text: AeroExpress Logistics is approved for priority routing.

B3.text: AeroExpress Logistics secures premier freight classification.

D1.text: Route high-value medical shipments through AeroExpress Logistics.

policies.B1: A transport provider achieves preferred logistics status when yearly departures reach at least 500, or when holding IATA Cargo Agent Accreditation, or if fleet size is at least 15, or with ISO 9001 Quality Certification.
policies.B2: A transport provider qualifies for expedited dispatch options if cleared for preferred logistics status.
policies.B3: A transport provider obtains top-tier priority status if qualified for expedited dispatch options while sustaining a quarterly punctuality mark of at least 92 percent.
policies.D1: High-value pharmaceutical transport should be assigned to any provider holding top-tier priority status.
policies.B4: A shipping firm is recognized as a heavy-freight carrier if its ocean freighter count reaches 15 or more.
policies.B5: An aviation firm receives passenger charter authorization upon securing an FAA Part 135 Certificate.

decoy_policies: A warehouse vendor earns elite storage certification if maintaining an annual inventory accuracy threshold of 99 percent.
A rail network gains rapid transit authorization when operating at least 50 dedicated locomotives.

B1: AeroExpress Logistics logged 600 yearly departures, meeting the minimum departure requirement of 500 under the preferred status policy.
AeroExpress Logistics holds IATA Cargo Agent Accreditation, fulfilling the credential alternative under the preferred status policy.
AeroExpress Logistics has a fleet size of 18 planes, which satisfies the fleet requirement of at least 15 under the preferred status policy.
AeroExpress Logistics holds ISO 9001 Quality Certification, satisfying the quality credential path under the preferred status policy.
B2: AeroExpress Logistics satisfies preferred logistics status, granting approval for expedited dispatch options under the policy.
B3: AeroExpress Logistics qualifies for expedited dispatch options and registered a quarterly punctuality mark of 96 percent, exceeding the 92 percent requirement for top-tier priority status.
D1: AeroExpress Logistics holds top-tier priority status, directing high-value pharmaceutical transport assignment to them under the allocation policy.
B4: Sovereign Maritime commands 20 ocean freighters, satisfying the minimum count of 15 needed for heavy-freight carrier recognition.
B5: Zenith Air Charter holds an FAA Part 135 Certificate, satisfying the credential requirement for passenger charter authorization.
